units.source_text: 倾盆而下的沙子，打在他的脸上。

en.t: Sand poured down in torrents and struck his face.

units.source_text: 从领口灌进了衬衫，冰凉的感觉眼见着一点点增加起来。

en.t: It poured through his collar into his shirt, and the cold sensation visibly grew little by little.

units.source_text: 火热的气息在嘴边燃烧。

en.t: His burning hot breath seemed to blaze at his lips.
